findings.description: The code does not check if the input `N` is too large, which could lead to buffer overflow when allocating shared memory.
The code does not handle potential race conditions when accessing shared memory.
The code exits immediately on errors without cleaning up resources.
The `rand()` function is not suitable for cryptographic purposes and can be predictable.
The program does not sanitize input arguments, which could lead to command injection if the program is extended to accept more complex input.
